_comment: P3067 (user t580u): LAST-RESORT default power, used only when nothing can be measured or calculated and the user set no rated power. All values are APPROXIMATIONS (W). Precedence: measured > calculated (VxIxPF, integration) > user rated-power > per-couple default > per-driver rule > per-class default. Battery/no-mains devices get null (no estimate). Each value carries why/source.

light.why: typical 806 lm LED bulb (EU energy label class E/F ~8 W), Zigbee radio standby ~0.3 W

socket.why: relay/switch module: controlled load unknown -> conservative 40 W; relay coil + radio ~0.4 W

windowcoverings.why: tubular curtain/blind motor ~30 W only while moving

curtain.why: curtain motor ~30 W only while moving

garagedoor.why: controller relay; motor power not switched through Homey estimate -> conservative

heater.why: electric heater default 1000 W, user should set the real load

thermostat.why: mains heating thermostat: per-load default 1000 W while heating; battery TRVs excluded below

vacuumcleaner.why: battery robot, dock charging not observable -> no estimate

other.why: unknown mains load behind a switch -> same conservative 40 W as relays

sensor.why: battery or negligible mains draw -> no estimate

driverRules.why: LED strip ~12 W per metre at full white; 1 m assumed, set real length x W/m
dimmer: controlled load unknown -> 40 W conservative
plug without meter: only its own standby is known (~0.5 W); set the plugged load
battery, hybrid or unknown-load device -> no estimate rather than a misleading one
small HEPA purifier / humidifier 15-40 W typical
